segments.narration: Every year, utility companies in Georgia and South Carolina file billions in future grid construction — and they plan it blind to what their neighbors are building next door.
Co Grid compares more than three hundred real filed projects from nine utilities across both states — and finds where crews, corridors, and construction windows collide.
segments.note: gentle pan across state, lines/glows visible

segments.narration: Here on the Savannah River, Dominion and Georgia Power are rebuilding parallel corridors. Tier one — literally touching, in the same twenty twenty-six build window.
segments.note: wheel-zoom onto the T1 zone at the river

segments.narration: Every opportunity is ranked — distance tier, shared timeline, and the actual filings behind it, with a snapshot drawn on real geography, not a cartoon.
